title: feat: complete February 2026 Priority Roadmap protocol schemas
body:
Implements all remaining protocol specifications for the 5 priority areas in the February 2026 roadmap. Moves 17 items from 🔴 to ✅.

### Comments & Collaboration API
- Added `pinned`/`starred`/`pinnedAt`/`pinnedBy`/`starredAt` to `FeedItemSchema`
- Pin/Star, SearchFeed, and Changelog API endpoints + contracts in `feed-api.zod.ts`
- `ChangelogEntrySchema` with field-level audit trail backed by existing `FieldChangeEntrySchema`

### Automation Execution Protocol (`automation/execution.zod.ts` — new)
- `ExecutionLogSchema` / `ExecutionStepLogSchema` — step-by-step flow execution history
- `ExecutionErrorSchema` — structured error tracking with severity and diagnostics context
- `CheckpointSchema` — pause/resume state capture for wait nodes, screens, crash recovery
- `ConcurrencyPolicySchema` — max concurrent, lock scope (global/per_record/per_user), conflict strategy
- `ScheduleStateSchema` — runtime schedule persistence (next-run, pause/resume, consecutive failures)

### Chunked Upload Protocol (`api/storage.zod.ts`)
- `FileTypeValidationSchema` — whitelist/blacklist MIME + extension validation
- `InitiateChunkedUpload` → `UploadChunk` → `CompleteChunkedUpload` flow with resume tokens
- `UploadProgressSchema` — real-time upload progress tracking

### Data Export & Import Protocol (`api/export.zod.ts` — new)
- `CreateExportJobRequestSchema` / `ExportJobProgressSchema` — async streaming export with CSV/JSON/XLSX/Parquet
- `ImportValidationConfigSchema` — strict/lenient/dry_run modes with deduplication strategies
- `ExportImportTemplateSchema` — reusable field mapping templates with transforms
- `ScheduledExportSchema` — cron-based recurring exports with email/storage/webhook delivery

### API Discovery Enhancements (`api/discovery.zod.ts`)
- `ServiceInfoSchema`: added `version` and `rateLimit` (requests/min, burst, retry-after)
- `DiscoverySchema`: added `capabilities` (hierarchical feature descriptors) and `schemaDiscovery` (OpenAPI/GraphQL/JSON Schema URLs)

### Tests
116 new tests across 5 files. 208 test files, 5921 tests total — all green.
